newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firmer, retracement as NYMEX rises.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firmer, retracement as NYMEX rises.

text.p: Brent crude futures were firmer on Monday after just one lot traded, amid general expectations that profit taking might support the market initially.
July Brent was traded on SIMEX at $17.90 per barrel, up 20 cents per barrel from London. The front-month contract fell 62 cents in London on Friday to $17.70.
One broker said July could retrace to $18.00-$18.20 on Monday, but he would expect sellers to offer stiff resistance at those levels.

July NYMEX crude futures on ACCESS retraced some of New York's losses. It fell 87 cents in New York to $18.79 and was last traded on ACCESS at its intraday high of $18.94, for a gain of 15 cents on the day.
Technical weakness added momentum to fundamental weakness on Friday to knock NYMEX July to its lowest level in 16 months.
